title: What happens when a data center loses power?
sources: Uptime Institute Data Center Tier Standard
IEEE Industry Applications Data Center Reliability

lines.text: What prevents the internet from crashing when a massive hurricane knocks out power to cloud data centers?
lines.caps: What happens when a cloud *data center | loses *electricity?

lines.text: Massive facilities housing hundreds of thousands of servers are built like impenetrable digital fortresses.
The instant city utility power flickers, giant Flywheel or battery Uninterruptible Power Supply systems take over instantly.
lines.caps: Massive battery banks *kick in | within zero *milliseconds!

lines.text: They bridge the gap without losing a single watt of electricity to server racks.
lines.caps: Prevents servers from *losing | even a single *millisecond

lines.text: Within fifteen seconds, enormous two-megawatt locomotive diesel generators roar to life outside.
lines.caps: Locomotive diesel *generators | roar to life in 15 *seconds

lines.text: These generators have enough on-site underground fuel reserves to power a small city for days.
lines.caps: Stores enough diesel to *power | a small city for *days!

lines.text: The cloud stays online because data centers refuse to let electricity ever die.
